opportunities.title: Wolfson Music Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Outstanding secondary school-age musicians in junior departments and funding for undergraduates to purchase instruments at nine musical conservatoires across the UK.
opportunities.summary: Scholarships for outstanding secondary school-age musicians in junior departments and funding for undergraduates to purchase instruments at nine musical conservatoires across the UK.

opportunities.title: Wolfson Postgraduate Scholarships in the Humanities
opportunities.eligibility_summary: PhD students in the broad areas of history, literature and languages at six partner universities.
opportunities.summary: Scholarships for PhD students in the broad areas of history, literature and languages at six partner universities.

opportunities.title: British Academy Wolfson Research Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established and outstanding academics in the humanities.
opportunities.summary: Professorships to established and outstanding academics in the humanities to focus on a specific research programme while freed from teaching and administrative commitments.

opportunities.title: British Academy Wolfson Fellowships

amount.raw: Funding divided between time buy-out, research and travel expenses, and dissemination of findings.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers in the humanities who show exceptional talent in both research and public engagement.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships to early career researchers in the humanities to undertake a specific research project over three years with funding divided between time buy-out, research and travel expenses, and dissemination of findings.

opportunities.title: Royal Society Wolfson Fellowships
opportunities.summary: Fellowships to support UK universities and research institutions to recruit outstanding scientific researchers from overseas.

opportunities.title: Royal Society Wolfson Visiting Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scientific researchers from overseas for a 12-month flexible period of sabbatical leave.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for a 12-month flexible period of sabbatical leave to foster closer collaboration with a UK host organisation and the wider UK scientific community.

opportunities.title: Cara Fellowships Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early and mid-career researchers fleeing persecution or danger in other parts of the world.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support The Council for At-Risk Academics (Cara) Fellowships Programme, which provides opportunities at UK universities for early and mid-career researchers fleeing persecution or danger in other parts of the world.
